problem: The final website pass still allowed uneven pricing CTA geometry, variable header height, empty section whitespace and portal visual models that could feel oversized or escape their cards at narrower widths. Post-merge browser readback also exposed a hydrated mobile topbar regression at 287.34px and a preview assertion still pinned to superseded proposition copy. On the refreshed main base, exact preview evidence confirmed the compact mobile rewrite passes, while deterministic parity still referenced superseded portal heading copy.
root_cause: Functional and content parity were already covered, but the final responsive geometry contract was only partially encoded in CSS and regression tests. A later-loaded <=430px portal-polish rule overrode the compact two-column action row, while the preview workflow still grepped legacy copy. The mobile browser contract and the live-parity copy contract had drifted independently from the canonical hydrated portal.
decision: Lock card/CTA geometry, public header height, empty-shell suppression and portal visual containment at desktop, tablet and mobile breakpoints. Preserve the compact action row after hydration and keep preview assertions aligned to the canonical Powerhouse wording. Reapply the compact mobile header on the latest main epoch and align live parity to the canonical heading.
prevention: Pricing CTAs use a fixed row height and flex cards keep their CTA at the bottom.
The canonical public header has explicit desktop/tablet/mobile minimum heights.
Genuinely empty section shells do not reserve vertical space.
Portal model visuals are width-contained and progressively capped at 1180, 900 and 640 pixel breakpoints.
Responsive geometry is guarded by the website coherence regression test.
At <=430px the hydrated action row remains minmax(0,1fr) + auto instead of stacking every action vertically.
Portal live-preview assertions check the canonical 'Zo werkt Powerhouse in je bedrijf' wording rather than superseded copy.
Source-level proposition tests inspect the rendered product-truth constant, not legacy-cleanup regex literals.

Replay assertions must match the actual finalizer implementation shape: productTruth is a template literal and product insertion is anchored to mainStart/firstSection rather than obsolete pr-hero variables.
The <=430px compact action-row contract explicitly sets display:grid!important because topbar-actions.css otherwise wins the cascade with display:flex!important after hydration.
At <=430px the hydrated shell hides the non-essential welcome subtitle, uses a 24px heading and 40px utility controls so the 390px browser contract stays under 260px.
Portal live parity uses the canonical heading 'Zo werkt Powerhouse in je bedrijf'.
